messages.english: The official catalogue describes Soil Depth Release 2, a national model of soil-profile depth. It links raster downloads and map services.
The catalogue lists updates as not planned for this release.
The Soil Depth Release 2 dataset record lists Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
The model does not measure individual fields or beds. Raster downloads and map services were not tested, and this reference does not approve crop recommendations.
